label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), D1 step
explanation: An end-of-episode unit. It never fires before episode trial ~85: 99% of activation mass falls in trials 90-99, and all of it on steps where the value head is in its lowest bin (<5.2), consistent with the agent knowing little reward is left. Within those trials it fires mainly at D1 (90% of mass), sometimes at D2 (10%), and never at GO. Magnitude ramps up toward the last trial and is larger when the D1 reward input is 1 and after a2 choices. Weak D1 activations in the first few of those last trials are mostly what it misses, and early-in-range D1 steps after no reward are mostly the false positives. Adding (prev_reward==1 | ep_trial>=94) raises dev F1 only from 0.73 to 0.76, so I recorded the simpler predicate. It uses only observed or internally computable variables (the trial count).
